- run_python: runs Python 3 code in your working folder and returns what it prints. pandas, numpy and duckdb and pypdf are installed. There is no internet. Nothing is remembered between calls, so re-load what you need each time.
- submit_answer: call this exactly once, when you are done, with your answer as a JSON object in the format the question asks for.

Work only with the files in your working folder. If the data can't settle part of the question, say so in the answer (for example "not stated") rather than guessing.

reasons.GSE21618: The drug is not 4-OHT. GEO and paper_2 only say 'tamoxifen' (Sigma-Aldrich, 1 uM) and never call it 4-hydroxytamoxifen, while the other studies used 4-OHT (trans-hydroxytamoxifen / OH-Tam / 4-OH tamoxifen). Other problems: the design mixes wild-type and tamoxifen-resistant (TamR) MCF-7, which have to be split out; the cells were serum-starved before treatment and profiled as a time course (0-48 h), mostly with one sample per time point, often given together with E2 or HRG; and the data were summarised with a custom RefSeq CDF (GPL10371) instead of standard probesets.
reasons.GSE111151: There is no 4-OHT treatment experiment. The study only compares untreated parental cell lines with tamoxifen-resistant derivatives (e.g. MCF-7 Tam1) kept on 1 uM 4-OHT for 8-12 months, so there is no vehicle-vs-4-OHT contrast in ordinary MCF-7. Being on drug is confounded with being resistant, and there is one sample per line with no replicates. The processed values were also TMM-normalised together with patient data (GSE58708) and batch-adjusted.
